newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stocks continue morning gains.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stocks continue morning gains.

text.p: U.S. stocks opened higher on Monday, extending Friday's rally into record-high territory.
The New York Stock Exchange set trading curbs after the Dow industrials gained 69.58 points to 7,505.36 while the Nasdaq composite rose 7.70 to 1412.54.
The 30-year U.S. Treasuries was off 5/32 at a yield of 6.79 percent. The Standard & Poor's futures index was up 4.20 at 866.70.
